_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Phase-Out Transition Plan
summary: The Phase-Out Transition Plan describes the transfer of full assumption of duties at each site to the follow-on contractor.
use_relationship:
The Phase-Out Transition Plan provides a detailed description of the transfer of full assumption of duties at each site to the follow-on contractor.
This Data Item Description (DID) contains format and content preparation instructions for the data product generated by the specific and discrete task requirement as delineated in the contract and described in the Performance Work Statement (PWS). It should be tailored to the minimum data requirements of the applicable contract or purchase order.
This DID supersedes DI-MGMT-81945.
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Content.
preparation_instructions.content: The Phase-Out Transition Plan shall include:

children.title: A written comprehensive plan explaining actions required to complete the total transition effort within a sixty (60) calendar day transition period.
Details of accounts and subscription services to be terminated or transferred.
Process to conduct a full joint inventory and transference of all Government Furnished Material inventory including all records.
Status of all items in inventory as well as the items that have been inducted into repair facilities, being modified or are being purchased.
Details for the removal of all contractor owned items.
Critical path schedule for risk mitigation of the transition period.
Plan to make training and certification records available of contractor personnel who are considering employment with the succeeding contractor.
